Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, sr As Object, s As String, i As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c", "d"))
    ws.Range("B1:B5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 3, 2, 5))
    ws.Range("C1:C5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 7, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5")
    Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlExponential
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLogarithmic
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlPower
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlPolynomial
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlPolynomial, 3
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlMovingAvg
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlMovingAvg, , 3
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, , , 1, 0.5
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, Name:="Fit"
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, Intercept:=2
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines.Add xlPolynomial, 2
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Delete
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Order = 4
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlPolynomial, 2: sr.Trendlines(1).Order = 7
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlPolynomial, 7
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlMovingAvg, , 1
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlMovingAvg, , 5
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add 9
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Type = xlLogarithmic
    Case 22
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Name = "Mine"
    Case 23
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Forward = 2
    Case 24
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: s = TypeName(sr.Trendlines(1).Parent) & ";"
    Case 25
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(2).Trendlines.Add xlLinear: s = ch.SeriesCollection(2).Trendlines(1).Name & ";"
    Case 26
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        s = sr.Trendlines.Count & ";": sr.Trendlines(1).Delete
    Case 27
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 28
        ch.ChartType = xlBarClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 29
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 30
        ch.ChartType = xlArea
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 31
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 32
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear
    Case 33
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlMovingAvg, , 4
    Case 34
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlPolynomial, 6
    Case 35
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, , , 1, 0.5
    Case 36
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, Intercept:=2: s = sr.Trendlines(1).Intercept & ";" & sr.Trendlines(1).InterceptIsAuto & ";"
    Case 37
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: s = sr.Trendlines(1).InterceptIsAuto & ";" & sr.Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation & ";" & sr.Trendlines(1).DisplayRSquared & ";"
    Case 38
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, DisplayEquation:=True
    Case 39
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).DisplayRSquared = True
    Case 40
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear, Name:="Fit": sr.Trendlines(1).NameIsAuto = True
    Case 41
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Period = 3
    Case 42
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlMovingAvg: sr.Trendlines(1).Period = 3
    Case 43
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Type = xlMovingAvg
    Case 44
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Forward = -1
    Case 45
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Trendlines.Add xlLinear: sr.Trendlines(1).Backward = 1
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    s = s & sr.Trendlines.Count
    For i = 1 To sr.Trendlines.Count
        s = s & "|"
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Type
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Order
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Period
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Forward
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Backward
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Name
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).Index
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
        s = s & "," & sr.Trendlines(i).NameIsAuto
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Next
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 45
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
